rdf:Description.dc:source: Original raster image generated with GPT Image 2.5: ChatGPT Image Sep 14, 2026, 08_28_21 PM.png
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Codex (SVG conversion)
rdf:Description.dc:description: Converted to SVG by Codex using Python and vtracer for vector tracing, Pillow for raster preprocessing and pixel validation, svgpathtools for path bounds, CairoSVG for rendering validation, and Python standard library xml.etree.ElementTree for SVG construction and editing. Python dependencies were managed with uv. The SVG was cropped to the sign bounds and given an opaque white sign-shaped background with transparency outside the sign.
